{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Zani |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = So, {{Rover}}, were you satisfied with how I handled your reception before the {{Extra Effect|Carnevale|Carnevale|The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, a time with never-ending masquerades, wine flowing like rivers, and music pulsing through the night.
During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.}}? Why bring this up now, you ask? Well, gathering client feedback is part of my job. As the {{Extra Effect|Montelli|Montelli|One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.
The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.}} family's esteemed guest, your opinion naturally holds a special weight for me. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = For an employee of the {{Extra Effect|Montelli}} family, appearance is everything. No matter how busy the day gets, always present yourself flawlessly. The Employee Manual puts it best: "Impeccable etiquette and attire give you the upper hand in negotiations." |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = I don't hate work or overtime, so long as it serves a purpose. If I'm forced to sit idly at a desk doing nothing or sacrifice my personal time on trivial tasks... Then what I'm earning isn't a salary, it's compensation for the piece of my soul that's been taken. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = You look tired, {{Rover}}. I understand you're shouldering some heavy burdens. But I suggest you catch a break whenever you can. You don't want to end up like me. Once I pulled my first overtime, I soon found myself working around the clock. Trust me, saving the world can wait. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I used to think life was nothing but living the same day on repeat. Grinding through trivialities, running in circles until even the smallest joys faded away. But then you came along, just as I'd grown numb to this way of living. Like the {{Extra Effect|Carnevale}} itself, you brought a burst of color into my life. |vo_02_01_title = Zani's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I ''love'' my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea. |vo_02_02_title = Zani's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Listen, efficiency is everything at work. It's all about hitting the nail on the head. Some people just don't get it. Instead, they waste so much time on unimportant details, prioritizing form over substance. A shame, really. That won't solve anything. All it does is complicate things even more. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Employees of the {{Extra Effect|Montelli}} family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I grew up in {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}}, and I know every corner of this city like the back of my hand. The sea breeze that greets you, the bustling plaza filled with familiar faces, the shiny new products in shop windows, the aroma of food from Trattoria Margherita. I hope this quiet life never ends. I hope everyone finds their place. For me, that would be enough. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Hmm? Why is this pocket watch so big? Well, this is not a pocket watch per se, but an alarm clock. In the early days when I worked for the {{Extra Effect|Montellis|Montelli|One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.
The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.}}, I almost caused a major incident by being late. After that, I've carried this alarm clock with me everywhere and I haven't been late since. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = My past? Nothing worth mentioning, really. I clock in, do my work, clock out—then do it all over again. Now and then, I straighten out a few troublemakers. Were you expecting some "white-collar hero saves the day" kind of story? Then you've read too many comic books. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Carlotta]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to {{Extra Effect|Ragunna}}, or even {{Extra Effect|Rinascita|Rinascita|A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.
Legends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.}}. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality. |vo_04_01_mention = Carlotta |vo_04_02_title = About [[Phoebe]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Phoebe.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = To me, {{Extra Effect|Ragunna}}'s fate lies in the will of its people, not the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}. Many {{Extra Effect|Acolytes|Acolyte|Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.}} would call this heresy, but not Phoebe. That's what makes her unique. She would never dismiss another's beliefs or efforts just because they do not align with her own. |vo_04_02_mention = Phoebe |vo_04_03_title = About [[Cantarella]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Cantarella.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = The {{Extra Effect|Fisalia|Fisalia|The most enduring and enigmatic family in Ragunna, the Fisalias are renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison crafting. Their unwavering devotion to the Sentinel is well-known among the citizens.}} family has always clung to {{Extra Effect|Ragunna}}'s traditions, stubbornly resisting change. But Signorina Cantarella, the current head, isn't as traditional as people imagine. As an employee, I do not get to influence how the {{Extra Effect|Montellis}} handle their relationship with the Fisalias... but personally, I wouldn't mind working with her. |vo_04_03_mention = Cantarella |vo_04_04_title = About [[Brant]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Brant.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the {{Extra Effect|Troupe of Fools|Troupe of Fools|A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."
To reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.}}, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going. |vo_04_04_mention = Brant |vo_04_05_title = About [[Ciaccona]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Ciaccona.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = I've seen Ciaccona perform a few times outside the city. She often sings about {{Extra Effect|Rinascita}}'s old folklore. I once asked her if she thought the age of heroes described in her poems had ended, whether heroes had already exited the stage of history. She answered that as long as there is suffering, someone will rise up to be the new hero. |vo_04_05_mention = Ciaccona |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = It's your birthday today right? According to {{Extra Effect|Ragunnesi|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}} tradition, we must put aside all work and throw a grand party with all our friends. Nobody leaves before midnight! Rest assured, I've already lined everything up in Palazzo Agrotta. Today, my job is to make sure you have all the fun. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Alright, where are we off to next? |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort Sounds) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Time to get back to work. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I am Zani. I work for the {{Extra Effect|Montelli}} family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list? |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = You're in good hands. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Rest assured. I'm on call 24/7. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now... |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything? }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Zani |language = en |basic_1_tx = That all you got? |basic_2_tx = I'm just getting warmed up. |heavy_1_tx = And that was me holding back. |heavy_2_tx = Pathetic. |heavy_3_tx = I'm just getting warmed up. |resskill_1_tx = Come at me! |resskill_2_tx = Give me your worst! |resskill_3_tx = You barely made a dent. |resskill_4_tx = Is that all? |resskill_5_tx = Just in time. |resskill_6_tx = Try this! |resskill_7_tx = Hmph, you asked for it. |resskill_8_tx = Don't stand in my way! |resskill_9_tx = Reduced to dust. |resliberation_1_tx = I don't have all day. |resliberation_2_tx = I can spare a minute to knock some heads around. |resliberation_3_tx = All of you at once.
